forbidden_shortcuts: auth refusal counted as a served miss

attribution.miss_signal: HTTP 404 plus opat present and ostore absent; opat includes the cargo URL-map co-read
attribution.padded_signal: total includes the deliberate 404 timing pad and is retained only as end-to-end context
attribution.legacy_alias: oother maps to ohandler once; conflicting or missing required phases fail the probe

invariants: unauthenticated controls and authenticated miss samples are separate populations
PAT values, random keys, response bodies, headers, and personal data never enter the committed artifact
fixed phase vocabulary keeps metric cardinality bounded; descriptor cache-tier text is not emitted
the timing pad remains enabled; instrumentation does not alter status, route, auth, or storage decisions
a missing phase cannot be interpreted as zero latency
the probe performs only GET requests and cannot close the issue without fresh external evidence

closure.target: median authenticated miss latency in the order of low tens of milliseconds
required_receipt: median and p90 for wall time and fixed attribution phases
closure.current_blocker: staging origin, deployed version, owner-approved tenant, and staging PAT are external prerequisites for a fresh receipt
closure.backlog_reconciliation: deferred until the external receipt exists

prohibited: PAT or tenant secret values in GitHub
